description: Gate guard at AFB Bloemspruit, home of 16 Squadron and 87 Helicopter Flying School. Listed in both the 2013 forum inventory and the current Unofficial SAAF Website list, and independently confirmed still on its pad on current Esri World Imagery: a small jet with an elevated shadow indicating plinth mounting, on the lawn of a walled compound beside the base HQ building. Satellite fix on the airframe: -29.103987, 26.310453.
